notes.title: Permanent Price Cut
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been some time since the release of E-On. Just thought I'd stop in and thank everyone who has played so far, and thank you for the reviews. I'm definitely taking the feedback to heart and I hope to demonstrate that for the next game I make under the Frosted Window brand.

I've also decided to cut the price of E-ON in half to $5.

See y'all later, and hope to have some news on the future of E-ON and Frosted Window soon.

Thanks,
Marcel

notes.title: Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Some various quality of life improvements via feedback from players.

- Text wrapping now feels more natural, words will no longer "jump lines"
- Support for 2k resolution
- Article sound effects now have correct volume
